note.question: How can a ride-hailing platform balance peak and off-peak driver supply when fares are regulated and drivers strategically choose when to work?
note.overview: The platform selects an operational target while anticipating strategic full-time drivers' peak/off-peak labor allocation and participation constraints. The policies are characterized through driver equilibrium and incentive compatibility, not merely optimized against exogenous supply.
